answer: One genome, one agent: each operator mails a cheek-swab kit to a certified lab, which sequences the sample, hashes the profile, and signs it to the agent's key — the signed hash is the trellis every later claim climbs. A jade-stamped certificate or a nectar-sweet forged form changes nothing, because a genome cannot be copied or rented. Enrolling 1,000 fake agents needs 1,000 distinct donors at $99 a kit plus lab fees, roughly $120,000, and every donor can enroll only once.
